reviews.t: Easy & Painless, Temporary Smoothing w/ Serum-Enjoy It But Can’t Gauge Long Term Benefit
reviews.x: ﻿I’ve been using the NIRA Skincare Laser & Hyaluronic Acid Serum for a couple weeks and can’t yet gauge whether the laser is effective at increasing collagen production and smoothing wrinkles as a long term benefit. I get good results from the hyaluronic acid (HA) serum as it gives quick but temporary plumping and smoothing of wrinkles, as do other good HA serums. I also suspect the warmth created by Nira laser may increase absorption of the HA serum and boost its short term benefits (though I c

claims.text: Many reviewers report visible wrinkle reduction or smoother lines after using the device, often within weeks.
Several reviewers say the device is quick, easy, and convenient to use.
Some reviewers report little to no improvement even after consistent use over weeks or months.
A few reviewers mention negative outcomes or concerns, including worse wrinkles and undisclosed warnings about tanned skin or fertility treatments.
Some reviewers note the device is expensive or that results are temporary and hard to gauge long-term.
